about.title: About BuMayed
about.p1: BuMayed is a UAE-built marketplace dedicated to motors: cars, motorcycles and boats. We connect buyers and sellers directly across all seven emirates — no middlemen, no hidden fees.
about.p2: Whether you are an individual selling your car or a dealer managing a full showroom, BuMayed gives you the tools to reach serious buyers in both English and Arabic.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I post an ad?
faq.a1: Create a free account, click “Post an Ad”, choose your category and follow the guided steps. Your ad goes live after a quick moderation review.
faq.a2: Yes — standard listings are free for individuals and dealers. Optional promotions (Featured, Premium, Urgent) give your ad extra visibility.
faq.q3: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a3: Every listing has Call and WhatsApp buttons that connect you directly with the seller. BuMayed does not get involved in your negotiation.
faq.a4: Dealers submit their trade licence and documents through the dealer dashboard. Our team reviews them before a verified badge is shown.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.p1: These draft terms govern the use of the BuMayed marketplace. By using the site you agree to provide accurate listing information and to comply with UAE laws.
terms.p2: BuMayed is a classifieds platform: we do not take part in the sale, payment or delivery of vehicles and are not a party to any transaction between buyers and sellers.
terms.p3: Final legal wording will be provided and approved by the client before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: This draft policy explains what data BuMayed collects (account details, listings, contact preferences) and why: to operate the marketplace and connect buyers with sellers.
privacy.p2: We never sell your personal data. Final wording will be provided and approved by the client before launch, in line with UAE data protection law.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, feedback or partnership enquiries — reach us on any of these channels.

footer.aboutBlurb: BuMayed is the UAE marketplace for cars, motorcycles and boats. Buy and sell directly, in English and Arabic.
